title: The Priest's Warning
summary: A village priest writes that the cult's Faithful are casting real spells now. To fight magic you have to learn it. Build an Inscription Table (Iron's Spells) and gather arcane essence.

goals.say: Runes crawl across the wood as if they have been waiting.

quest_book.title: A Priest's Warning
quest_book.author: The Priest
pages: The Faithful who burned Ashford were not only axes and torches. Some of them cast fire with their hands.
That is evoker magic, stolen and sold. Build an inscription table. Learn to write spells. Then go and take back what they stole.
